tools.name: presign_check
tools.description: Call before your agent signs anything. Send tx fields (to, data, value, chainId), or typedData (an eth_signTypedData_v4 payload), or untrusted text, with an optional wren-guard policy. Returns block, review or allow, the decoded call and every finding: unlimited approvals, permits, Permit2, setAppro

tools.name: screen_text
tools.description: Call before your agent acts on untrusted text (a reply, DM, web page, tool output or memory). Returns safe, suspicious or malicious with the matched patterns, after decoding base64, hex, Morse, leetspeak, ROT13, reversed and hidden Unicode. Optional known: your own addresses, to flag poisoned lookal

tools.name: token_facts
tools.description: Call before your agent approves, receives or sends a Base ERC-20. Returns code size, EIP-7702 delegation, name, symbol, decimals, supply, proxy and upgrade admin, owner or renounced, and which privileged functions the bytecode has (mint, pause, blocklist, fees, limits, trading switch, upgrade). Fact

tools.name: presign_demo
tools.description: Free. Runs one fixed example (an unlimited approval, setApprovalForAll, a never-expiring permit, an EIP-7702 delegation, an injected memo or a normal x402 payment) through the same checker, so you can see the report shape before paying for presign_check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: presign_check · Private data: presign_check, screen_text, token_facts · Public sink: presign_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: presign_check · Private data: presign_check, screen_text, token_facts · Public sink: presign_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
